_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global biopharmaceutical company, consisting of global pharmaceutical/biotechnology and international consumer medicines businesses, whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious disease' (FY2010 10-K, Item 7); 'We face intense competition from other pharmaceutical manufacturers, including both innovative medicines and lower-priced generic products.' (Item 1A heading); 'Market exclusivity for PLAVIX* and AVAPRO*/AVALIDE* in the U.S. is expected to expire in May 2012 and March 2012, respectively.' (Item 1A heading); 'It is possible that we may lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -65.2%/yr (worst year FY02-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.5%/yr (Q2 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.7-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.5%/yr (FY02-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +83.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2011-09-23) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.63x (90.3% downside to Bear $3 / +142.8% upside to Bull $75) | Adj composite 3.23 vs market 1.62: gap +1.61 [UNDERVALUED] | -9% above the EPP floor $34 (16x FY11E $2.13) | Conservative 2-yr case: +65.8% total (+32.9%/yr) | At 14.5x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $41 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +14.7% in Q2 2011, forward revenues +10% (no FY11 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2011 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
